# huge-output
reconstructed: synthesized 200k-line build transcript, generated by
`../gen-huge-output.js` (checked in; the generated `build.stdout` is small
enough — well under 5MB — to commit directly, so no .gitignore/pretest step
is needed). `build.stream = 0` means unbuffered/no per-line delay, to
exercise the streaming sink under high line-count throughput.
